description: Fetch one URL with conditional GET; extract, date, score, classify listing-vs-article AND source type (blog/forum/social/video/news/commercial/docs via host rules + HTML fingerprints, stamped even on failed extracts); blobstore the text; queue discovered links deduped and depth-capped. Tolerates 'null' env ints; sniffs gzip by magic number.
name: Scout Fetch

description: Insights are now REPLACED per run instead of accumulating; diagnostics over articles only.
name: Scout Health

description: Index the OWNER'S own published articles from their sitemap (urls + lastmod only, never page bodies). Writes solely to p-scout-owned, so owner content can never enter the findings corpus, and scout-taxonomy can subtract what is already covered.
name: Scout Owned Inventory

description: Keep watching: re-queue every known source host's root + busiest article sections into the frontier. Conditional GETs make unchanged pages a 304; only new links survive dedupe. Honours brief.denyHosts.
name: Scout Recrawl

description: Widen the crawl via a search API (brave|tavily|serper, whichever key is present). Emits frontierCandidates at depth 0, deduped against the registry and filtered by the brief's denyHosts. Key via $SEARCH_API_KEY, never in a token.
name: Scout Search

description: Deterministic rollup + expansion tracking: re-buckets findings by CURRENT age first, rolls counts by category and source type, maintains per-host profiles (p-scout-sources), appends growth snapshots (p-scout-growth), joins own inventory for trueGaps, and withholds the facts token when the corpus is unchanged and the analysis fresh — no model call for zero new information.
name: Scout Taxonomy

description: Draft ONE accepted article task end to end: deterministic prep (task + competitor text with URL-fallback + related own slugs + brief), then invoke the LOCAL claude binary headlessly (-p, no tools, no session persistence) and file its markdown as a draft token. Dedupe by drafts ledger; the task token is never consumed. Requires Claude Code on the executor host.
name: Scout Write (Claude Code)
